title: GEE (Google Earth Engine) Provider
description: Tiles from Google Earth Engine map IDs. Used for real-time satellite analysis products.

body.url: GEE tile URL with {z}/{x}/{y}, typically formatted as: https://earthengine.googleapis.com/v1alpha/projects/.../maps/{mapid}/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}. Usually generated server-side and stored here.

options.tileSize: Optional tile size. Defaults to 256 in the frontend.

layer_config_schema.type: Optional legacy field. The current OpenLayers adapter only requires body.url.
layer_config_schema.decodeFunction: Optional runtime field supplied outside the stored layer_config for special canvas-decoded layers such as SPARC visualizers.
layer_config_schema.decodeParams: Optional runtime parameters paired with decodeFunction; not typically persisted in layer_config.

examples.description: GEE tile layer with pre-computed map ID URL
GEE tile layer with explicit tile size

notes: GEE tile URLs are typically generated by a separate backend or Lambda workflow and stored in layer_config.
The current frontend uses the stored tile URL directly; token refresh/proxying is not yet the default path.
For new GEE layers, body.url is required and interaction_config is still required on the Layer record, typically '{}'.
